9. Final check: all balls 1–10 at roomb, Robby at roomb, both grippers free.

1. Open boot (precondition: boot closed/unlocked; frees access to tools and wheels).
2. Take pump from boot (precondition: boot open, hand free).
3. Inflate r1 with pump (precondition: pump held, r1 intact/not inflated).
4. Inflate r2 with pump (precondition: pump held, r2 intact/not inflated).
5. Take wrench from boot (precondition: boot open, hand free).
6. Loosen nut nuts1 on the-hub1 (precondition: wrench held, nut tight).
7. Take jack from boot; jack up the-hub1 (precondition: boot open, hand free).
8. Undo nut nuts1; remove w1 from the-hub1 and put w1 in boot (precondition: hub jacked, nut loose, hand free).
9. Mount inflated r1 on the-hub1; tighten nut nuts1 (precondition: hub clear, r1 inflated, wrench held).
10. Repeat steps 6–9 for the-hub2 with nuts2, w2, and r2 (precondition: wrench/jack available, hub2 accessible).
11. Lower jack and return jack, pump, wrench to boot (precondition: hubs mounted, hand free).
12. Verify: r1/r2 inflated and on hubs; w1/w2 in boot.

8. Mount inflated ri onto the-hubi (precondition: hub clear, ri inflated, hand free).
9. Fasten nut nutsi with wrench; lower jack; return jack and wrench to boot.
10. Repeat steps 5–9 for hubs 2, 3, 4 (ordering: each hub independent, but tools shared—return tools before next hub).
11. Verify all wheels inflated, mounted on correct hubs, and w1–w4 in boot.

1. Open boot (precondition: boot closed/unlocked; hand free) to access tools and wheels.
2. Take pump from boot (precondition: boot open, hand free).
3. Inflate r1, r2, r3 with pump (precondition: pump held, wheels intact/not inflated).
4. Return pump to boot (precondition: hand free).
5. For each hub i=1..3: take wrench from boot; loosen nut nutsi on the-hubi (precondition: wrench held, nut tight).
6. Take jack from boot; jack up the-hubi (precondition: jack held, hub fastened/on ground).
7. Undo nut nutsi; remove wheel wi from the-hubi to boot (precondition: hub raised, nut loose, hand free).
8. Mount inflated ri on the-hubi (precondition: hub clear, ri inflated, hand free).
9. Fasten nut nutsi with wrench; lower jack; return jack and wrench to boot.
10. Verify all wheels inflated, r1–r3 on hubs, w1–w3 in boot.

6. Mount r1 onto the now-clear hub the-hub1 (hub raised, nut removed, hand free).
7. Reinstall nut nuts1 and tighten with wrench; lower jack.
8. Verify r1 is on the-hub1 and w1 is in boot.
